title: SECRET job searching on LinkedIn? 🔎
description:
LinkedIn's new feature is HUGE. When you upload your resume to LinkedIn, even if your profile isn't fully built out, your experience will still be searchable by recruiters. Maybe you don't want to update your profile because you don't want anyone from your current company to see it's been updated (probably a sign you're looking for something new)—this is the way to get all those important keywords in there and you'll show up much higher in the search. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
